message.lasttrain.intro: The front door has three locks: a padlock (key), nailed boards (crowbar) and an electric lock (fuse in the basement fuse box). Sneak, hold your breath (V), hide in wardrobes, throw bottles to lure it away. It can't enter your bedroom.

message.lasttrain.boarded: You're on the train. The doors are closing...
ending.lasttrain.title: The End
ending.lasttrain.escaped.2: The house dissolved into the dark behind the window.
ending.lasttrain.missed.1: The train's lights vanished around the bend.
ending.lasttrain.missed.3: And behind you, the footsteps started again...

diary.lasttrain.page1:
You have 3 days.

Live them as you want. Build, dig, run.

On the third night it will come for you.
diary.lasttrain.page2:
Day two.

The moon is bleeding.

If you see a tall black figure - do NOT look at it.
diary.lasttrain.page3:
Day three.

Tonight you will fall asleep and wake up in the big house.

It is blind. Be quiet.
Find the key. Catch the last train.

note.lasttrain.1:
Father told us not to make a sound. He says it can hear us even breathing.

- Lisa
note.lasttrain.2: Mother doesn't speak any more. She sits in the chapel counting candles.
note.lasttrain.3:
Father put out his own eyes. He said that way he would hear better.

Now he walks at night.
note.lasttrain.4:
The train comes once a night. It takes those who make it.

The rest stay here. With him.
note.lasttrain.5: My doll moved again. She sings the lullaby when nobody is looking.
note.lasttrain.6:
If our family photo burns in the fireplace, it will all end.

But only for someone who knows the whole truth.
ending.lasttrain.freed.1: The photo curled up in the fire.
ending.lasttrain.freed.2: Somewhere in the house something screamed - and fell silent.
ending.lasttrain.freed.3: The family is finally at peace. The curse is lifted.
